## Description

What does this change and why. Link the issue: fixes #

## Checklist

- [ ] One logical change, diff kept as small as practical
- [ ] Commits signed off for the DCO (git commit -s), matching your commit author identity
- [ ] AI assistance, if any, disclosed with a Co-Authored-By or Assisted-By trailer in the commit body
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Tests added or updated, covering expected and error paths
- [ ] CI is green
- [ ] SPDX license header on new files
- [ ] Pull request title follows Conventional Commits (the changelog is generated from it)
- [ ] ADR merged first if this changes architecture, a public interface, or a spec
